messages:
Carla R: Follow-up to the VPC private endpoints discussion: proposing an operator-driven tenant handshake that uses ephemeral certs and a staged migration. Posting a concrete plan for feedback.
Carla R: Short version: phased regional rollout, operator issues ephemeral client certs per-tenant (short TTL, e.g., 1h), agents support automatic renew + fail-open to legacy token for 14 days. Fallback is regional shared endpoint.
Alice M: main worry is customers that rely on preserved source IP. Per-tenant peering keeps srcip but costs more and increases route churn.
Brian W: Exactly. Options:
  - Per-tenant peering: preserves srcip, more route entries and vpc-attachments.
  - Shared regional endpoint: fewer attachments, requires SNAT to preserve semantics.
  We should only offer per-tenant peering at higher SLA/paid tier.
Matt K: For on-prem / air-gapped installs, we need an offline bootstrap. How do we sign/rotate without Redwood KMS calls?
Carla R: Two bootstrap modes:
  * Online: operator requests ephemeral certs from Redwood KMS and pushes to tenant agent via operator API.
  * Offline: customer generates CSR locally, operator signs CSR offline (or customer brings own signed cert), agent loads cert and connects. TTL for offline certs longer (24h) with manual rotation guidance.
Jen S: proposed operator API endpoints:
  - POST /operator/v1/tenants/:id/bootstrap -> returns bootstrap-token
  - POST /operator/v1/tenants/:id/certs -> CreateEphemeralCert
  - PUT /operator/v1/tenants/:id/certs/:cert_id/renew -> Renew
  - DELETE /operator/v1/tenants/:id/certs/:cert_id -> Revoke
Brian W: testing matrix suggestions:
  - certificate expiry race (simulate renew delays and clock skew)
  - handshake failure load (simulate N% handshake failures and ensure fallback)
  - peering route churn: add/remove 100 tenants rapidly and measure route update QPS
Alice M: DNS and client caching: recommend TTL=30s for controlplane endpoint during cutover windows. But many clients ignore TTLs; we need a long-lived fallback window and circuit breaker.
Carla R: rollout safety plan:
  1) Observe-only config for 2 weeks (no active switchovers; collect metrics)
  2) Non-prod canary: 8-12 tenants in a single region
  3) Gradual ramp: add regions during low-traffic windows (nightly)
  4) Auto-fallback: proxy-level circuit that routes to shared regional endpoint for 10m on handshake spike
  5) Manual override in Console with immediate rollback
sre-bot: Draft alerts created:
  - controlplane.handshake.error_rate > 1% for 5m
  - operator.cert_renew.failures > 3 in 10m
  - per-tenant.peer.route_throttle > threshold
ops-bot: Canary operator deployed to namespace private-ephemeral-canary v0.1
Matt K: backward compatibility: agents must implement RenewFromOperator() + a short fail-open mode to support old token for a grace period. We'll require agent v2.1+ for production cutover.
Jen S: Console/UX items: show endpoint auth mode (shared | per-tenant), cert expiry timestamp, last handshake status, and a SRE "force-fallback" control. Add an audit trail for operator actions.
Brian W: cost impact: per-tenant peering adds attachment cost + route table growth. I'll model monthly delta per-tenant and propose gating in billing+plans.
Alice M: also think through observability: add handshake traces with tenant_id and trace_id, surface in Console traces tab. Add a debug view for last 100 handshake attempts per tenant.
Carla R: operator handshake sketch (pseudocode):
```
# online bootstrap
POST /operator/v1/tenants/42/bootstrap -> {bootstrap_token}
operator -> request ephemeral cert from KMS
operator -> push cert to tenant-agent via agent-control channel
agent -> connect mTLS to tenant endpoint
```
Carla R: offline sketch:
```
# offline bootstrap
customer -> generate CSR locally
customer -> upload CSR to operator (offline sig flow) or operator provides signed cert via secure transfer
operator -> sign and hand back cert or provide signed artifact
customer -> load cert into agent
agent -> connect
```
Jen S: rollout tasks (owners):
  - Brian: cost model + tier gating
  - Alice: Console mockups + admin controls
  - Matt: offline bootstrap docs + customer playbook
  - Carla: operator API PR + handshake automation
  - SRE: alerts + dashboards + tracing
Brian W: I'll put a cost spreadsheet by Tue EOD. We should present two pricing options: opt-in per-tenant peering (enterprise) and default shared endpoint.
Alice M: I'll have UI mocks Wed and include the force-fallback checkbox and expiry countdown.
Matt K: I'll draft the offline playbook and the agent compatibility matrix. Need guidance on TTLs we permit for offline certs.
Carla R: next steps: I'll open the RFC follow-up PR with operator API and migration runbook. Target internal beta in ~3 weeks behind a feature flag.
sre-bot: Note: recommend adding a synthetic test that rotates certs every 45m to validate renewal under load.
ops-bot: Canary tests running: handshake success 99.7% over last 20m, no regressions observed.
Jen S: If no objections in 24h I'll convert this to the formal RFC-followup and schedule the PR reviewers. :thumbsup: 
Brian W: +1
Alice M: +1
Matt K: +1
Carla R: thanks all, will post PR link here once opened.
